A [[human]]<ref name="Episode VII" /> [[Gender|man]]<ref name="TFA junior" /> was a '''warlord''' in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]. At one point, he was [[Assassination of an Inner Rim warlord|assassinated]] by the [[Knights of Ren]].<ref name="Legacy of Vader 8" /> Later [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], a [[Force-sensitive]] scavenger who hailed from [[Jakku]], saw the assassination in a [[Force vision]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Mark Stanley]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=markstanley2020|url=p/B_xgg3Thfax|name=[[Mark Stanley]]|date=2020-05-04|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/hwHP6}}</ref> During the production, the character was known as "clan leader".<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/682962831998730241|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Now that the script's out - It's somewhere else. Production identified that warrior as 'clan leader'.|archivedate=20160301221205}} {{C|Note that the original post has been taken offline}}</ref> His role was incorrectly called a "[[Knights of Ren|Knight of Ren]]" in the movie's credits.<ref name="Episode VII" />
